name: Binnui
title: Levite and Rebuilder of Jerusalem's Wall
summary: Binnui is a name that appears several times in the post-exilic books of the Old Testament. He is best known as a Levite who participated in rebuilding Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah, and as one of those who sealed the covenant with God. Several individuals by this name were also involved in the issue of foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Binnui, son of Henadad, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Further Work on the Wall
keyEvents.description: Binnui worked on another section of the wall, from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.

keyEvents.title: Sealing the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Binnui was among the Levites who sealed the covenant to follow God's law during Nehemiah's renewal of the covenant.

keyEvents.title: Return from Exile
keyEvents.description: Binnui is mentioned among those who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel, as part of Israel's restoration.

keyEvents.title: The Question of Foreign Wives
keyEvents.description: Several men named Binnui were among those who had taken foreign wives and, during Ezra's reforms, committed themselves to sending them away.

keyEvents.title: Levitical Service at the Reading of the Law
keyEvents.description: Binnui was among the Levites who helped the people understand the law when Ezra read it aloud to the assembly.
